# `messages` — `/api/messages`

Messages: private conversations between two members, with photos and files.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/messages/conversations`](#get-api-messages-conversations) | Member | The person's conversations, most recent first. |

|---|---|---|---|---|

<a id="post-api-messages-uploads"></a>
### `POST /api/messages/uploads`

Starts uploading a file for Messages, up to the Messages size limit.

- Handler: [`start_file`](../../../backend/community/messages.py)
- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `FileStart`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
